args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the latest deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west), the service was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback status: healthy in all regions, error rate 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001. The service is healthy again.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, the service reports healthy, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is open, and creating it paged the on-call engineer. It describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery, and notes that the v2.3.1 problem needs to be found and fixed before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
